g.text: Everygen wants 12 short vertical videos for October. The focus is the new
jelly flavour, shown by real creators in their own kitchens. Each video
opens with a strong hook in the first two seconds.
Show the product in the first 3 seconds
One clear call to action at the end
I tried every jelly so you don't have to
This is the only snack my kids fight over
POV: you found the good jelly
